tools.name: search_founders
tools.description: Search approved Founderhood listings by city, country, category, keyword, or cofounder opt-in. Each result includes open_to_cofounder and cofounder_note. heard_from is not returned.

query.description: Keyword search across name, description, location

open_to_cofounder.description: When set, only approved listings with this cofounder opt-in value

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: List cities with approved founder listings and counts.

tools.name: get_founder
tools.description: Fetch one approved listing by its URL slug, including open_to_cofounder and cofounder_note. heard_from is not returned.

slug.description: Business slug from the listing URL

tools.name: submit_listing
tools.description: Submit a new business for human review. Same validation and rate limits as POST /api/submit. Accepts open_to_cofounder, cofounder_note, and optional heard_from (stored as mcp when omitted). heard_from is stored for admin review only. Requires founder consent. A website host that is already listed or under review is rejected; the error includes slug only when that listing is approved. Only submit businesses that meet the listing criteria: A business you run with a real website: a product, SaaS, app, service or local business people can use or buy today, built to last. One-trick trend generators (one photo into this week's viral clip) are not listed; A real website with substance: what it does, who is behind it and how to reach you. No placeholder or "coming soon" pages; One listing per business, no duplicates. Running several projects is fine: submit each one that has its own site; Its own product, not a borrowed name: building on someone else's AI model is fine, but a site named after the model (Sora, Nano Banana, Seedance…) is not listed; Plays by the rules of the platforms it builds on: nothing that breaks the terms of X, Google, Reddit or others (scraping, reply bots, fake engagement); Submitted to be found, not for a backlink: no SEO-only content sites, other directories, link-building services or mass directory submissions; No MLM, get-rich-quick schemes, trading bots or signals, gambling, or adult content; Accurate city and country for where the founder is based.

open_to_cofounder.description: Mark founder as open to finding a cofounder

cofounder_note.description: Short note for cofounder search (if open)

heard_from.description: Optional. How the founder heard about Founderhood. If omitted, stored as "mcp". Preferred values: x, directory_list:<short text> (bare directory_list is still accepted), google, ai_assistant, friend, reddit, newsletter, or other:<short text>. Admin-only; never returned by search_founders or get_founder.
